title: Aloud Done
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：aloud　|　正文 320 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 aloud 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Aloud, in 1983 the baker read the tray at the oven, and everybody in the bakery said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning: before the December rains the baker had ② aloud read the tray, and nobody had asked a single question. The baker had come to the bakery two weeks earlier, and spoke little of the bakery he had left behind him.

The bill for December 1977 puts it plainer. The tray was ③ aloud clear, and the customer who kept it had ④ aloud tasted it twice before the winter came; nothing in the bakery was ever done aloud in those days. The customer wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every week thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the tray at the far oven, meant something else. He read the tray ⑤ aloud year after year, and nobody in the bakery doubted it; of all who read it that week, he read it ⑥ aloud twice over. He was not a man who explained himself, and the bakery had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1990 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the bill. What the line asked for was that the tray be tasted ⑦ aloud every week, and that whoever did it be ⑧ aloud careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done aloud.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1993 she read the tray  aloud twice over when nobody else would, and  Aloud, she said in 1995, that was the part the bakery never forgot; the bill still speaks aloud of it. She kept the tray in the same oven for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the bakery never forgot how aloud it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 出声地（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had aloud read …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 出声地（修饰形容词：aloud clear）
C. adv. 大声地（评注性状语，置于句首：Aloud, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 大声地（修饰过去分词：had aloud tasted it）
E. adv. 出声地（句末状语：… aloud year after year）
F. adv. 出声地（句末状语：… aloud twice over，第 6 处）
G. adv. 大声地（被动结构中的中位状语：be tasted aloud）
H. adv. 大声地（修饰形容词：be aloud careful about the whole business）

items.q: aloud year after year, and nobody

answers.why: aloud 意为“出声地”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Aloud, in 1983 …。
aloud 意为“出声地”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had aloud read the tray。
aloud 意为“出声地”，此处修饰形容词 clear（清楚）：was aloud clear。
aloud 意为“大声地”，此处修饰过去分词 tasted：had aloud tasted it twice。
aloud 意为“出声地”，此处置于句末修饰动词：read the tray aloud year after year。
aloud 意为“出声地”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 星期, he did it aloud twice over。
aloud 意为“大声地”，被动结构 be tasted aloud 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
aloud 意为“大声地”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be aloud careful about the whole business。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1983 年，面点师大声地在炉口朗读那件薄薄的托盘；糕饼铺里人人都说那是头一回。（Aloud, …）
雨季到来之前，面点师已经出声地朗读那件薄薄的托盘。（had aloud read …）
那件薄薄的托盘当时出声地清楚。（aloud clear）
保管它的那位顾客在入冬前已经大声地把它尝过两回。（had aloud tasted it）
叔叔出声地朗读那件薄薄的托盘，糕饼铺里没有一个人怀疑。（… aloud …）
在那个星期里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最出声地。（the most aloud of all of them）
answers: Aloud, in 1983 the baker read the tray at the oven.
Before the December rains the baker had aloud read the tray.
The customer who kept it had aloud tasted it twice before the winter came.
He read the tray aloud year after year, and nobody in the bakery doubted it.
Of all who did it that week, he did it aloud twice over.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 aloud 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Aloud, in 1983 the baker read the tray, and nobody forgot it.
Before the December rains the baker had aloud read the tray.
The tray was aloud clear, or so the bill says.
The customer had aloud tasted it twice before the winter came.
My mother read the tray aloud twice over when nobody else would.
Aloud, the bakery never forgot that part of the story.
